WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(CASE WHEN f.feerate != 0 THEN f.rebrate / f.feerate ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_count FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.avg_ratio,
    s1.record_count,
    s1.record_count - s2.avg_count as count_diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s1.record_count > s2.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as result_col1,
  SUM(record_count) as result_col2,
  AVG(count_diff) as result_col3
FROM step3
